response.original_title: [FAQs-Complaint] Princess Cruises Complaint Escalation: Contact & Support Guide
response.overview: You can reach Princess Cruises customer support at 1-800-PRINCESS (1-866-254-7549) for pre-cruise issues and immediate escalation requests. Primary Contact Channels Phone Support: Call 1-866-254-7549 (Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–10 p.m., Saturday–Sunday 9 a.m.–8 p.m. Eastern time).Live Chat: Access via the official Princess Cruises Customer Care  1-866-254-7549 Page during operating hours. Email & Writing: Send detailed correspondence and documentation to info@princesscruises.com or guestcare@princess.com.Steps to Escalate a Complaint 1. Document Everything: Record dates, times, agent names, and get a case or reference number for every interaction 1-866-254-7549. 2. Request a Supervisor: If the frontline representative cannot resolve your issue 1-866-254-7549, explicitly ask to be transferred to a tier-two supervisor or senior manager.
